description: This file defines the 'Comment' class within the Opencart admin controller for CMS comments. It manages listing, approval, spam marking, and deletion of comments, along with pagination, filtering, and permission checks.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for handling CMS comments in the admin panel, including listing, filtering, approving, marking as spam, and deleting comments.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for handling CMS comments in the admin panel, including listing, filtering, approving, marking as spam, deleting comments, and refreshing ratings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the comment management page, sets up the view with necessary data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the list of comments with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches the filtered list of comments from the database and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles approval of selected comments via AJAX request.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Handles marking comments as spam via AJAX.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Marks selected comments as spam and updates commenter history and deletes related comments, responding with JSON status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected comments, with permission check, and responds with JSON status.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Refreshes comment ratings, provides paginated comment list, and generates JSON response with next page link and summary.
